paragraphs: Sheilat, Shmuel's father. The geonim said Sheilat was a woman, R' Hiyya's sister. This is not so: Gittin and Helek report that descendants of Haman studied Torah in Benei Berak. Heilprin identifies Rav Shmuel bar Sheilat as one of them. They would not mix their family—R' Hiyya's family, meaning—with converts, since they descended from Shim'i, David's brother [אחי דוד, as transmitted]. Yuhasin brings Rabbah bar Sheilat; I have not found him.
